topic: She must have been using her phone
title: She must have been using her phone
pt: Foco da aula: must have been + -ing: dedução sobre atividades passadas

solo90.name: Pausa

lines.en: Zoe, did you see that woman? She walked straight into a lamp post. She must have been using her phone.
lines.pt: Zoe, você viu aquela mulher? Ela bateu direto num poste. Ela deve ter estado usando o celular.

lines.en: Probably. She must have been reading a message, because she was staring at her hands the whole time.
lines.pt: Provavelmente. Ela deve ter estado lendo uma mensagem, porque olhava para as mãos o tempo todo.

lines.en: Or she must have been listening to music. She was wearing headphones, so she was oblivious to everything.
lines.pt: Ou deve ter estado ouvindo música. Ela usava fones, então estava alheia a tudo.

lines.en: You must have been watching her closely! I was looking at the bus, so I only heard the noise.
lines.pt: Você deve ter ficado de olho nela! Eu olhava para o ônibus, então só ouvi o barulho.

lines.en: I was waiting for you, and I could not help but notice. She must have been walking fast, too.
lines.pt: Eu estava esperando você e não pude deixar de notar. Ela deve ter estado andando rápido também.

lines.en: She was not hurt, though. Her friend must have been laughing, because I heard laughter right after.
lines.pt: Ela não se machucou, porém. A amiga deve ter estado rindo, porque ouvi risadas logo depois.

lines.en: It happens all the time. Yesterday a cyclist nearly hit me, and he must have been checking directions on his phone.
lines.pt: Isso acontece o tempo todo. Ontem um ciclista quase me atingiu, e ele deve ter estado vendo o caminho no celular.

lines.en: Pedestrians are so distracted these days. We must have been doing the same thing when we were younger, honestly.
lines.pt: Os pedestres estão tão distraídos hoje em dia. Devíamos estar fazendo o mesmo quando éramos mais jovens, sinceramente.

lines.en: Not with phones! We must have been talking so much that we did not see where we were going.
lines.pt: Não com celulares! Devíamos estar conversando tanto que não víamos aonde íamos.

lines.en: True. Look, the woman is sitting on that bench now. She must have been feeling embarrassed.
lines.pt: Verdade. Olhe, a mulher está sentada naquele banco agora. Ela deve ter estado se sentindo envergonhada.

lines.en: Let us check that she is fine. After all, anyone could have been the one walking into that pole.
lines.pt: Vamos ver se ela está bem. Afinal, qualquer um poderia ter sido quem bateu naquele poste.

facts.label: Dedução sobre o passado
facts.sub: Quase certeza sobre ação em andamento: She must have been texting. Negativa: can not have been. Menos certeza: might have been.

facts.label: Must have been
facts.sub: Para deduzir uma ação em andamento no passado: She must have been using her phone. Você tem quase certeza, mas não viu. Estrutura: must + have + been + verbo-ing.

facts.label: Can not have been
facts.sub: Para negar uma dedução, use can not ou could not: She can not have been sleeping. Evite mustn’t have been, que soa pouco natural em inglês britânico e americano.

pages.title: The lamp post accident · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny afternoon on a busy street in Adelaide. Eli and Zoe are waiting for a bus. Crowds of people pass by. Most of them stare at their phones. Suddenly there is a loud bang. A woman has hit a lamp post.

“Zoe, did you see that woman? She walked straight into a lamp post. She must have been using her phone.” says Eli. “Probably. She must have been reading a message, because she was staring at her hands the whole time.” says Zoe. “Or she must have been listening to music. She was wearing headphones, so she was oblivious to everything.” says Eli.
